title: Set up your first WhatsApp campaign
description: Create and send your first WhatsApp broadcast to a contact segment
examplePhrases: I don't know how to set up my first WhatsApp campaign
how do I send a bulk message

steps.title: Check WhatsApp is connected
steps.instruction: Open the 'Setup a channel' section and confirm WhatsApp shows Completed.

steps.title: Confirm WhatsApp is ready
steps.instruction: You should see a green 'Completed' check next to WhatsApp. Great — you're all set!

steps.title: Check your audience
steps.instruction: Open 'Build an audience' and confirm the CSV File tile shows Completed.

steps.title: Audience confirmed
steps.instruction: Contacts are uploaded. Now let's make sure you have an approved template.

steps.title: Check your templates
steps.instruction: Let's verify you have an approved WhatsApp template. Click 'Create content' to open it.

steps.title: Start a new campaign
steps.instruction: All set! Click 'New campaign' to begin.

steps.title: Name your campaign
steps.instruction: I've suggested a name. Check it and update it if you like.

steps.title: Choose a contact segment
steps.instruction: Pick the segment you want to message from the dropdown.

steps.title: Select WhatsApp as your channel
steps.instruction: Tick WhatsApp. You can untick Email and SMS for this campaign.

steps.title: Review and send
steps.instruction: Click 'Next' to review your campaign settings, then hit Send.
